The third line contains n integers b_1, b_2, …, b_n (1 ≤ b_i ≤ 10^5) — the number of occurrences of each word in the dictionary.

Output

Print the number of words in the dictionary that start with letter l.

Examples

The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) — the number of words in the dictionary. The second line contains a string s (1 ≤ |s| ≤ 10^5) — the word. The third line contains an integer m (1 ≤ m ≤ 10^5) — the number of words in the dictionary. The fourth line contains m space-separated integers a_1, a_2, …, a_m (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^5) — the number of words in the dictionary that start with the letter i.

Output

Print the number

The first line of each test case contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 100), denoting the number of words and the number of letters in the alphabet. The second line contains n words, each word consists of lowercase letters. The third line contains m letters, each letter is a lowercase letter.

The input is terminated by a line containing two zeros.

The output for each test case is a single line containing the number of words in the NATO phonetic alphabet that starts with the letter n.
